description:
3‑in‑1 60W fast charging travel cable (0.1m) is the compact “one cable for everything” solution for power banks, desk charging, and flights. It combines USB‑C, Lightning, and Micro‑USB outputs in one connector head, so you can charge iPhone, Samsung, OnePlus, Mi, Oppo, Vivo, iQOO and more without carrying three separate cables. With Power Delivery support up to 60W (20V/3A, device/adapter dependent), it’s built for fast top-ups on compatible phones, tablets, and even many USB‑C laptops.

The super-short 10cm length keeps your setup tidy—perfect for power bank pockets and minimalist workstations—while the inbuilt fold-out stand props your phone for video calls, watching reels, or navigation while charging. Add 480Mbps data transfer for basic syncing, and you’ve got a travel essential that saves space, reduces cable mess, and keeps every device ready to go.

features: 3‑in‑1 output tips in one head: Switch between USB‑C, Lightning and Micro‑USB without swapping cables—ideal for mixed-device homes and travel.
Up to 60W Power Delivery (20V/3A): Supports fast charging on compatible devices when paired with a suitable PD charger (actual speed depends on device/adapter).
Ultra‑short 0.1m (10cm) length: Perfect for power banks, car storage, laptop bags, and clutter-free desk charging—no cable spaghetti.
Built‑in fold-out phone stand: Props your phone upright for calls, reels, and navigation while it charges—great for airports and office desks.
480Mbps data transfer: Suitable for basic file sync and data transfer (USB 2.0 speed).
Durable PVC jacket: Designed for daily carry and frequent plugging without fraying easily.
Wide compatibility: Works with iPhone (Lightning), Android phones (USB‑C/Micro‑USB), tablets, power banks and common USB chargers.
